Name: Forest Nook Furniture
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
This mod adds a collection of forest themed, aesthetic natural pieces for your decorating needs.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3XeMvqh.png[/img]

Artist Bookcase - Ivy Bookcase
Bamboo Mat - Deep Forest Rug
Bed - Sage Single Bed
Brown Armchair - Forest Nook Armchair
Brown Couch - Forest Nook Couch
Coffee Table - Elmy Coffee Table
Dark Rug - Sage Shaggy Rug
Double Bed - Sage Double Bed
Futan Bear - Little Potted Plant
Modern Lamp - Forest Nook Lamp
Oak End Table - Elmy End Table


Hope you enjoy!
